description: This line plot illustrates the average cosine similarity between generated training samples for each relation category, as specified in the caption. The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans a range from 0 to 60 and is presented on a linear scale without explicit tick labels, though the data points are plotted at regular intervals corresponding to integer values. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers for “w/o DPO obo,” an orange line with triangular markers for “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” a solid green line with circular markers for “DPO,” a dashed blue line for “Average of w/o DPO obo,” a dotted orange line for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and a dashed green line for “Average of DPO.” The “w/o DPO obo” line starts at approximately 0.22, peaks near 0.49 at x=1, and ends near 0.0. The “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” line starts at 0.158, peaks near 0.44 at x=30, and ends near 0.0. The “DPO” line starts at 0.18, peaks near 0.19 at x=60, and ends near 0.086. The average lines are mostly flat, with the “Average of w/o DPO obo” hovering around 0.107 and the “Average of DPO” hovering around 0.086. The plot includes numerical annotations for the starting values of the “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” line (0.158), the “w/o DPO obo” line (0.107), and the “DPO” line (0.086).
